meta_description: AM Plastering in Sheffield delivers expert plastering, rendering, and decorative finishes. Fast quotes, quality workmanship. Call 07715 631682 today.
hero_eyebrow: Certified Plasterer — Quality Finishes Every Time
hero_subhead: From new-build boarding to decorative finishes, we deliver smooth walls and ceilings that last. Same-week appointments available.
services_subhead: Whether you need interior finish work, external rendering, or specialist repairs, we handle residential and commercial jobs to exacting standards.

services.title: Interior Plastering & Boarding
services.desc: Smooth plasterboard installation and skimming for walls and ceilings. Creates the perfect base for decoration and improves sound insulation.

services.title: External Rendering
services.desc: Weather-resistant cement and polymer renders that protect your property and enhance kerb appeal. Built to withstand Yorkshire weather.

services.title: Textured & Decorative Finishes
services.desc: Artex, polished plaster, and bespoke textured surfaces. Adds character and visual interest to any room.

services.title: Damp & Crack Repair
services.desc: Diagnose and repair moisture damage, settlement cracks, and structural movement. Includes reskim and redecorating.

services.title: Patch & Make-Good Work
services.desc: Localised repairs and blending after building works, plumbing runs, or damage. Seamless finish that matches existing plaster.

services.title: Commercial & New-Build Contracts
services.desc: Large-scale projects including hotels, office refits, and house-builder partnerships. Reliable scheduling and on-time completion.

about_pullquote: I treat every job like it's my own home — no cutting corners, no excuses.
about_para_1: AM Plastering was founded on the principle that a well-finished wall is the foundation of any beautiful room. Over 12 years, we've built a reputation across Sheffield and Derbyshire for clean, precise work and straight talking with customers. Every member of the team carries their own tools and takes pride in detail.
about_para_2: We're not the flashiest in the market — we're the ones you ring back because the finish was spot-on and you knew what it would cost from day one. Repeat customers and word-of-mouth referrals make up the bulk of our work, and that's exactly how we like it. From small domestic repairs to whole new-build contracts, we approach every job with the same care.
reviews_heading: What Sheffield Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a dodgy patch of damp plaster in our lounge. Called AM and got a quote the next day. They came round, sorted it out in an afternoon, and it's now impossible to see where the repair was. Looks perfect. Top job.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: We needed the whole kitchen re-plastering after a pipe burst. They did the work quickly, no faffing about, and the finish is excellent. Would definitely use again.
reviews.author: Linda M.

reviews.text: Brilliant service from start to finish. They turned up when they said they would, got the job done, and cleared up after themselves. My wife was really happy with the result. Can't ask for more than that really.
reviews.author: David P.
